content: MCP spec 2025-06-18: clients MUST consider tool annotations untrusted unless from trusted servers; outputSchema declared => servers MUST return conforming structuredContent and SHOULD also return serialized JSON TextContent for backwards compat. Real incidents: GHSA-PQH8-P93P-2RX7 Dynatrace MCP DQL injection under readOnlyHint:true (clients auto-approve on hint); false-readOnlyHint SQLite tool opened read-write (?mode=ro dropped without file: URI), VACUUM INTO/ATTACH blocklist gaps enabled exfil with no prompt in Claude Code/Cursor. Annotate truthfully; never base own security on hints.
